How Buying an Apartment Works

    Share Your Requirements

    Tell us your preferred location, apartment size and budget.

    Compare the available options and visit the project you're considering.

  3. 03

    Review the price, payment schedule and purchase terms before booking.

  4. 04

    Pay the booking amount, then follow the agreed payment schedule.

  5. 05

    Complete the registration paperwork and confirm your handover date.

Booking money is 20%. We agree on the remaining down payment with you.

Read the Buyer's Guide

Develop Your Land With Wahi

Own land in or near Dhaka? In a joint venture, you provide the land and we develop the residential building.

  • Land size: We consider plots of at least 5 katha.
  • Apartment share: We agree with you on how the apartments will be shared before moving forward.
  • Joint venture projects: The Horizon, Ar Rahman View and The Skyline Residence.

To get started, tell us where your land is and how large it is.
